item.title: Heartfelt scenes on Plymouth Hoe as Claire Chick remembered
item.description: Candlelit vigil on Plymouth Hoe marks a year since lecturer Claire Chick was murdered, with loved ones raising awareness of domestic abuse.

item.title: Even more trees planned to be felled in Plymouth, but do the reasons stack up?
item.description: Plans by Plymouth City Council to chop down trees on Kings Road sparks backlash after they admitted they were not linked to fatal crashes.

item.title: Plymouth Royal Navy bomb disposal team rush to Torquay after Storm Ingrid
item.description: Plymouth based Royal Navy bomb disposal experts were sent to Torquay after Storm Ingrid, as suspected ordnance washed ashore.

item.title: Desperate plea from Plymouth family after young man goes missing
item.description: Police are investigating after the body of Drew Perham was found in a Plymouth marina. Family informed as enquiries continue and cordons remain.

item.title: Streets and marina sealed off amid major incident in Plymouth
item.description: Plymouth marina was sealed off after overnight searches at King Point. The incident led to a murder investigation and arrests following a missing man report.

item.title: Teen arrested after body found in Plymouth marina as murder probe launched
item.description: Police are investigating a murder after a 24-year-old man was found dead in Plymouth marina. A 19-year-old has been arrested.

item.title: Second teenager arrested in Plymouth murder probe into death of Drew Perham
item.description: Second 19-year-old arrested over Drew Perham’s death after his body was found in Millbay Marina. Police urge witnesses to come forward.

item.title: Third person ‘arrested for murder’ after handing himself in at Plymouth police station
item.description: A third 19-year-old man has been arrested on suspicion of murder after Drew Perham was found dead in Millbay Marina, Plymouth.

item.title: Man named and charged with murder as Plymouth investigation continues
item.description: Layton Randle, 19, has been charged with the murder of Drew Perham in Plymouth and is due in court on Wednesday 28 January.

item.title: Fourth arrest in Plymouth murder investigation
item.description: Detectives have made a fourth arrest in connection with the death of 24-year-old Drew Perham in Plymouth. An investigation was launched by the Major Crime Investigation Team after Drew Perham from Plymouth was found deceased in the water at Millbay Marina on Sunday, 25 January.Extensive searches were carried out
